title: CTA-Flux: Integrating Chinese Cultural Semantics into High-Quality English Text-to-Image Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from culture-neutral prompts across four categories (people, architecture, cuisine, and festivals) and computing the CLIP feature similarity between the generated images and the textual concepts 'Chinese' and 'Caucasian' to measure cultural inclination.

Evaluating the model's text-to-image generation quality and semantic fidelity (using zero-shot FID and CLIP scores) when processing native Chinese prompts compared to English prompts, in order to measure the linguistic feature distribution gap of predominantly English-centric models.
